name: Durham College / UOIT–Scarborough Centre
description: School-oriented express bus between Scarborough Centre and the shared north Oshawa campus of Durham College and UOIT (now Ontario Tech). Some archive filenames incorrectly identify an original route 93 PDF as route 96.

timeline.event: The original timetable explicitly identifies the campus express as route 93.
School service was restored with additional weekday eastbound trips.
The route remained in the original school-year timetable.
The September service-change notice states that route 93 remained suspended.

These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
